description: The server dashboard. Existing shell commands remain guarded by trust.rs against the committed loopback or configured APP_BASE_URL origin. The four local SSH key commands additionally require HTTPS except loopback and native destination approval before a native file picker. The page receives only an opaque signer id, public identity, and public SSH-agent replies. Unlocking an encrypted key belongs exclusively to a separate bundled window. No generic filesystem/dialog grants, private keys, passphrases, or unlock authority reach this page. Wildcard remote URLs allow OAuth sign-in redirects; the committed-origin guards enforce authority.
